summary: Enrollment-based access to VA medical, mental health, pharmacy, preventive, specialty, and community care services.
enrollmentChannels: In-person enrollment at a VA medical facility
Mail or fax submission of VA Form 10-10EZ

priorityGroups.typicalEligibility: Veterans rated 50% or more service-connected or unemployable due to service-connected conditions.
Veterans receiving aid and attendance, housebound benefits, or determined catastrophically disabled.
Low-income veterans and many pension recipients.
Many toxic-exposed veterans, combat veterans in their enhanced eligibility window, and certain radiation-exposed veterans.
Higher-income veterans who do not meet a higher-priority category and are enrolled when capacity permits.

majorPrograms: Community Care when eligibility criteria are met
Caregiver support and social work services

relatedPrograms.name: CHAMPVA
relatedPrograms.appliesTo: Qualified spouses and dependents of veterans rated permanently and totally disabled or who died from service-connected causes.

relatedPrograms.name: Camp Lejeune family member reimbursement
relatedPrograms.appliesTo: Certain family members exposed during the contamination period under separate authority from standard veteran enrollment.
